unlisted_practices: Regulators should monitor the real-world performance of AI-enabled devices after authorization, with particular attention to diagnostic specificity and the risk of unnecessary care cascades from false positives.
Regulators should require post-market performance testing of AI-enabled devices in populations underrepresented in pivotal trials.
Regulators should apply an equity-focused approach that generates evidence on performance across populations, ideally at the pre-market stage, for AI-enabled devices generally.
Researchers should conduct post-market research on deployment of AI-enabled devices among providers in medically underserved and rural areas.

screen.reason: This is a commentary/viewpoint article examining the regulatory implications and clinical evidence surrounding the FDA authorization of DermaSensor.
